summary: Iter9 verified all 3 Escort-module polish enhancements end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 new pytest cases pass in 2.04s covering (a) GET /escorts/{id}/recent-visits (admin + escort token visibility, limit honoured, shape, auth required, today's check-in surfaced), (b) POST /escorts/{id}/invalidate (admin-only 403/401 gate, status='left' + ended_at + invalidated_by + invalidated_at stamped, invalidated escort's pre-existing JWT now 401s on /auth/me, 404 for unknown id), (c) Muster institution filter for escort tokens — GET /muster/athletes scoped to escort's institution (admin sees full list), POST /muster/checkin-bulk and /muster/checkout-bulk silently skip foreign-institution athletes with reason='outside your institution' while still mustering in-institution athletes; admin path unchanged. Frontend: /admin/institutions → YCH → Escorts panel shows 2 active escorts each rendering 'No visits yet' strip + amber Invalidate button (data-testid='escort-invalidate-{id}'). Clicking Invalidate, accepting confirm → toast 'TEST_UI_Escort_A invalidated', escort moved from ACTIVE (2 → 1) into LEFT (1) group with ended date stamp, Invalidate button removed. All UI testids resolve.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/escorts.py recent-visits (491): clean limit-clamp max(1, min(20, limit)) prevents abusive queries; projection keeps payload tiny; auth gate is just get_current_user (any logged-in user) which matches the docstring 'just dates, no selfies'. OK.

routes/escorts.py invalidate (502): admin-only via require_admin, stamps invalidated_by/invalidated_at + ended_at + status='left' atomically. server.py get_current_user (139) re-checks esc.get('status') != 'active' → returns 401 on next request, so previously issued JWTs lose access immediately. Clean terminal action.

server.py muster_athletes (3149-3154): escort branch hard-fails with 400 if escort somehow has no institution — safe. server.py checkin/checkout-bulk (3205, 3248): escort_inst is None for non-escorts so the institution gate is a no-op for admin/coach — confirmed by regression test. Skip-vs-403 strategy is correct for forgiving UX.

server.py phone_login (831-854): when no member matches, escort phone match issues an is_escort=true token without device approval — passwordless by design (one phone = one escort). This is consistent with the docstring.

frontend Layout.jsx (62-68): memberNav for escorts is constructed as NAV_MEMBER filtered to /escort-checkin PLUS Muster Roll. canMuster variable (58) doesn't include is_escort but that variable only gates the COACH section visibility in the sidebar — escorts intentionally don't get that header, they just get their two member-nav items. Behaviour matches spec.

frontend Institutions.jsx EscortRow (203-278): RecentVisitsStrip lazy-loads on mount only for active escorts via useEffect, sets visits=null initial → loading=true while fetching → renders empty/filled. invalidate() uses window.confirm and calls onChange() which triggers parent refresh. Clean. Sample chip title attr exposes In/Out times — nice touch.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 iter9 contract tests pass; full suite expected at 235/235 per prior baseline)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — admin escorts UI panel + invalidate flow verified end-to-end on YCH institution with two seeded test escorts

test_credentials: admin@attendance.app / Admin@12345 (working). Escort phone-login validated programmatically via the seeded TEST_Escort phone numbers; no UI escort-login path tested (out of scope — backend JWT routing already verified by test_invalidated_escort_token_rejected).
seed_data_creation: Tests create transient TEST_Escort_* and TEST_UI_Escort_* records (cleaned up via DELETE in fixture teardown and a post-test cleanup script). One TEST_Inst_* institution may be created if the DB has <2 institutions (cleaned up). Mid-run check-in attendance row left on the test escort (cleaned via DELETE /escorts/{id} cascade in routes/escorts.py:212).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter9 closed clean — all 3 enhancements (recent-visits strip, one-click invalidate, escort-scoped muster) ship as specified. Key selectors used: escort-row-{id}, escort-invalidate-{id}, escort-visits-{id} | escort-visits-loading-{id} | escort-visits-empty-{id}, escort-visit-chip-{id}-{i}, escort-group-active | escort-group-left | escort-group-replaced. Backend regression command: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q (full suite). New iter9 file is tests/test_review_iter9.py — 14 tests, ~2s. To exercise the escort-token muster path manually: POST /api/auth/phone with an active escort's phone → token carries is_escort=true → GET /api/muster/athletes returns institution-filtered roster. To test UI invalidate: log in as admin, /admin/institutions → click 'Escorts' on any institution with an active escort → click the amber Ban icon (data-testid='escort-invalidate-{id}') → confirm dialog → escort moves to LEFT group.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found; all acceptance criteria satisfied.
